main_body: Grey stove: a dark outlined body with a light grey top plate (rows ~9-13) with two small dark knobs, a grey front panel (rows ~14-30) with a dark firebox opening holding a flame
top_band: light grey-blue band at rows ~9-12 (with a lighter 1-2px strip at rows 12-13), about 4 rows including the front strip, but it reads as a flat panel with knobs, not a horizontal surface
evidence: Column read down the middle: dark outline at row 8, light grey band rows 9-12 with two knobs, a lighter strip at rows 12-13, then a dark gap and the mid-grey front panel from row 14 to 30. The top band is thin and nearly the same tone as the front. It looks like a control panel face with knobs, not a top surface seen from above. The firebox is a flat dark square with a flame drawn face-on, and no interior surface is visible. The whole piece is drawn as a front elevation topped by a light band, so it fails.

style.evidence: The stove has about 3 grey steps: a light top, a mid-grey body and a dark outline. The large front panel (about 10x16 px) is one flat grey with only a thin lighter left edge. The outline is a near-black, neutral dark grey, with little tint from the neighbouring material. Only the flame has more colours (yellow, orange, cream). Beodeul references have 5-6 steps, grain and per-material highlights, so the stove is much thinner and flatter next to them.
